steps.log: inject a conversation flow with three turns (prompt + reply each) into the reading column

steps.eval: (() => { const host = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]')?.parentElement ?? document.body; const column = document.createElement('div'); column.id = 'dshcb-test-column'; column.style.cssText = 'width:720px;max-width:calc(100% - 40px);margin:0 auto;'; const flow = document.createElement('div'); flow.id = 'dshcb-test-flow'; flow.setAttribute('data-slot', 'conversation.chat.flow'); for (let turn = 1; turn <= 3; turn += 1) { for (let part = 0; part < 2; part += 1) { const item = document.createElement('div'); item.setAttribute('data-chat-turn', String(turn)); item.setAttribute('data-chat-flow-kind', part === 0 ? 'user' : 'assistant'); item.style.cssText = 'height:60px;margin-top:' + (turn > 1 && part === 0 ? '20px' : part === 1 ? '6px' : '0') + ';background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:8px;'; flow.appendChild(item); } } column.appendChild(flow); host.appendChild(column); return 'injected'; })()

steps.check: one card is painted per conversation turn
each card spans the reading column width and uses the main scrim
steps.expr: (() => { const flow = document.querySelector('#dshcb-test-flow'); const layer = document.querySelector('.dshcb-turn-scrims'); if (flow === null || layer === null) return false; const width = Math.round(flow.getBoundingClientRect().width); const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dshcb-turn-scrim')]; return cards.every((card) => { const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect(); const style = getComputedStyle(card); return Math.abs(rect.width - width) <= 1 && Math.abs(layer.getBoundingClientRect().left - flow.getBoundingClientRect().left) <= 1 && style.borderRadius !== '0px' && style.backgroundImage.includes('linear-gradient'); }); })()

steps.check: cards keep a wallpaper gap between two turns
steps.expr: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dshcb-turn-scrim')].map((card) => card.getBoundingClientRect()).sort((a, b) => a.top - b.top); if (cards.length !== 3) return false; let ok = true; for (let index = 1; index < cards.length; index += 1) { const gap = cards[index].top - cards[index - 1].bottom; if (gap < 4) ok = false; } return ok; })()

steps.check: the card of one turn covers both the prompt and the reply
steps.expr: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dshcb-turn-scrim')]; return cards.length === 3 && cards.every((card) => card.getBoundingClientRect().height >= 120); })()

steps.check: the whole main column no longer paints one full-height scrim
steps.expr: (() => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; if (column === null) return false; const after = getComputedStyle(column, '::after'); return after.content === 'none' || after.content === 'normal' || after.backgroundImage === 'none'; })()

steps.check: the reading column is marked only while the cards exist
steps.expr: (() => { const flow = document.querySelector('#dshcb-test-flow'); if (flow === null) return false; return flow.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-read-column') || (flow.parentElement !== null && flow.parentElement.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-read-column')); })()
